करतोया

- नदी। {सo 9। 26।। वo 83। 3।। भीo 9। 35।। } A sacred river which flows through the Districts of Rungpur and Dinajpur. It formed the boundary between the kingdoms of Bengal and Kamarupa.

करालजनकः

- जनकवंशीयो राजा। तस्य वसिष्ठेन सह क्षराक्षरलक्षणविषये संवादः। {शाo -323।। }

कर्णाटकाः

- देशः। {सo 78। 98।।भीo 9। 59।। }The Province of Mysore and the District of South Canara in the madras Presidency, and the Districts of North Kanara, Belgaum, and Dharwar in the Bombay Presidency.

कर्वटः

- वङ्गदेशसमीपस्थो देशः। यस्य राजा ताम्रलिप्त। {सo 31। 25।। }

कारूषः

- क्षत्रियः। मनोः पुत्रः। {आo 69। 19।। }The eastern portion of the District of Shahabad, in the Province of Bihar.
